usage.ownKey: You're on your own model key, so what it writes isn't counted here. Web search and pictures still are.
usage.pro1: AI every session and every week, nothing to top up
usage.pro2: About 65 lessons' worth of AI a week
usage.pro3: 20 GB synced, and about half what the same AI costs in credits
usage.otherText: Free is everything that isn't AI. Without Pro, use credits (below), {key}, which is never counted, or {apps}, where your subscription there pays.
usage.todaySub: A little each day, from your first question.
usage.sessionSub: Five hours from your first question.
usage.weekSub: Seven days from your first question.
usage.creditsFree: On Free, credits are the AI: whatever you ask for spends them.
usage.creditsPro: Credits keep you going when a limit runs out, and aren't touched before then.
usage.creditsCost: A lesson is about 9 credits, a chat answer well under one.
usage.errNoSale: Credits aren't on sale yet. Nothing has been charged.
usage.errOwner: Only the owner of this account can buy credits.
usage.errCheckout: Could not open checkout. Try again in a moment.

prefs.quietSub: No AI buttons in your pages and boards. Your notes stay exactly as you write them. Cards and the plan keep working.
prefs.tryFirstSub: The assistant asks for your attempt before it answers, in every course. Graded work always works this way.
prefs.shareLabel: Share my results with my class
prefs.shareSub: Anonymous: counts only, never your name or answers. Class numbers show once 5 classmates are here.
prefs.errSave: That setting didn't save. Try again.
prefs.themeHint: System follows your device. The choice is saved on this device only.

assistants.intro: Ask about your deadlines, plan and notes there, and save notes, tasks and deadlines here. It runs on their plan, not your credits.
assistants.addressAria: BiliMind's address for ChatGPT and Claude
assistants.chatgpt: Plugins, then + and Add custom MCP server. Paste the link and sign in with BiliMind.
assistants.claude: Customize, Connectors, + Add, Add custom connector. Paste the link and sign in with BiliMind.
assistants.disconnected: {name} is disconnected. It can't read or add anything now.
assistants.errDisconnect: {name} wasn't disconnected. Check the connection and try again.
assistants.errCopy: Couldn't copy it. Select the link and copy it by hand.

calendar.intro: Add this link in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook as a calendar "from URL". It keeps itself up to date; Google checks it a few times a day. What you change there doesn't come back.
calendar.oldStops: Calendars using the old link stop updating.
calendar.mistake: Shared it by mistake? Make a new link
calendar.madeNew: New link made. The old one no longer works.
calendar.errMake: The link wasn't made. Check the connection and try again.

backup.title: Back up everything
backup.text: One zip with every course and My notes: pages as Word and Markdown, whiteboards as pictures, deadlines, tasks and grades as a spreadsheet, and flashcards as CSV and text.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.text: Deletes your courses, notes, chats and files, and stops any subscription. This can't be undone.

openrouter.title: OpenRouter · BiliMind
openrouter.connected: OpenRouter is connected. Your AI now runs on your OpenRouter account.
openrouter.errConnect: OpenRouter couldn't be connected. Try again.

connect.title: Connecting · BiliMind
connect.incomplete: This link is incomplete. Start connecting again from ChatGPT or Claude.
connect.failed: That didn't go through. Go back to ChatGPT or Claude and try connecting again.
connect.head: Connecting your BiliMind…
connect.signedIn: Signed in as {name}. Next you choose what to allow.

notion.title: Bring in your Notion · BiliMind
notion.heading: Bring in your Notion
notion.intro: Your pages come in as pages. A table of assignments comes in as deadlines for you to check on Today; none is added until you say so.
notion.step1: In Notion, open Settings, then Export.
notion.step2: Choose Markdown & CSV, and turn off files and images.
notion.askShare: Notion asks which pages to share with BiliMind. The pages inside them come too.
notion.sharedFrom: Shared from {workspace}. Tick what to bring in, up to {max} at a time.
notion.nothingShared: Nothing is shared yet. Change what’s shared and tick the pages you want.
notion.bring: Bring in {n} page | Bring in {n} pages
notion.errPages: Notion didn’t answer. Try again in a minute.
notion.errZip: That zip didn’t come in. Check the connection and try again.
notion.errOpen: Notion couldn’t be opened. Try again.
notion.errImport: Those pages didn’t come in. Try again in a minute.

practice.emptyText: Every card is resting until its next date. That's the point: you'll see each one again just before you'd forget it.
practice.summary: {n} answer in about {minutes} min, {remembered} remembered. Each card comes back on its own schedule, just before you'd forget it. | {n} answers in about {minutes} min, {remembered} remembered. Each card comes back on its own schedule, just before you'd forget it.
practice.nextCheck: Your next check on these opens {when}.
practice.howWell: How well did you remember it?
practice.hint: "In 10 min" is when you'll see the card again. Keys 1 to 4 work too.
